If the answer is yes, be careful.

points.title: Projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond (Book Value model)
points.question: What is the company's projected annual compounding return as an equity/bond? Take the company's average per share return on equity for the last ten years and subtract the average percentage that is not retained and is paid out as a dividend.
